name: motion-studio
description: Code-driven motion graphics: Claude writes a deterministic seek(t) composition, Chromium renders it, FFmpeg encodes it.

scripts.render:all: node render.mjs --format 9x16 && node render.mjs --format 1x1 && node render.mjs --format 16x9
scripts.build: node render.mjs --sub 4 && node sfx.mjs && bash scripts/mux.sh && bash scripts/contact.sh
